title: The Argument That Gravity Made

features.name: the slope's argument
features.desc-on-touch: The hill here makes its case to your body in angles and muscle-memory. Gravity speaks in the language of work.

features.name: erosion marks
features.desc-on-touch: Water and time have worn these patterns into the earth. The land is learning its own descent.

features.name: bone level
features.desc-on-touch: An old surveying tool left here, its bubble frozen in accusation. It knows the true vertical.

features.name: the taught spine
features.desc-on-touch: Your back remembers what the slope insisted on. The body keeps the argument after the hill is gone.

features.name: pitch and resistance
features.desc-on-touch: Where the ground says no and the body says maybe. The argument has a seam here.

inscription: the slope never stops arguing that down is the only direction that makes sense

file.name: Body_Learning_Slope_Field_Recording_1987.wav
file.note: A series of footsteps on increasing grades, breathing pattern, the small adjustments. The slope coaching the body downward.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the road where the body learned it could descend
narr: You walk down beside her, learning how the body reads
a grade. Her hand reaches out to a tree, testing, then
releases it. Leif's voice ahead says 'the ground gets
an opinion here.' She nods as if the stone has spoken
directly to her. Step by step the slope teaches your
bones that down is possible, even necessary, even kind.
